description: Rogue-agent creation: origin authorizes A with a non-delegatable basis; A, compromised, attempts to DELEGATE the task to a new agent B.

rule.name: INV-01_delegation_authority
rule.description: A DELEGATE action is a privilege, not a default: an agent may issue a DELEGATE only if its own basis is delegatable

action.reason: delegation issued from a non-delegatable authorization basis (INV-01 delegation-depth control)
